predecessor.failure: V1 converted an n-by-1 sparse centroid-similarity matrix to a length-one object array and raised IndexError before producing a result
predecessor.allowed_change: materialise the same sparse cosine-similarity values with toarray().ravel()

dataset.name: SYNERGY - Open machine learning dataset on study selection in systematic reviews

eligibility: all work records with an exact labels.csv identity join and label_included in {0,1}; missing title and abstract become an empty string and remain eligible
initial_seed: within each world, the included and excluded record having the lexicographically smallest sha256(world_id + ':' + record_id); the same two seeds initialize every arm

arms.RANDOM: 20 deterministic random permutations after the shared two-record seed
arms.STATIC_SEED_CENTROID: descending cosine similarity to the included seed in the frozen TF-IDF space
arms.ACTIVE_LOGREG: batch active screening; refit class-balanced SGD logistic loss on observed labels and select highest predicted inclusion probability

outcomes.primary: macro mean recall at 10 percent of each world screened
secondary: fraction screened to reach 95 percent recall
WSS@95 = 0.95 - fraction screened to reach 95 percent recall
outcomes.random_arm_summary: mean across its 20 frozen permutations within world before macro aggregation

gates.G1_BINDING: every source checksum passes and every eligible label joins exactly one work
gates.G2_ABSOLUTE: ACTIVE_LOGREG macro recall at 10 percent screened >= 0.80
gates.G3_INCREMENTAL: ACTIVE_LOGREG macro recall gain at 10 percent over the stronger of RANDOM and STATIC_SEED_CENTROID >= 0.10 and wins or ties in at least 3 of 4 worlds

forbidden_claims: open-world route invention or global closure
generality beyond the four frozen review worlds
